content_sections.heading: About CSIR-CECRI
content_sections.text: CSIR-Central Electrochemical Research Institute (CSIR-CECRI) is a laboratory of the Council of Scientific & Industrial Research, located in Karaikudi – 630 003. The posts in this addendum are for its project GAP 25/26.

rows.event: Walk-in interview (Engineering, Chemical Science & Technology, Nanoscience & Technology)

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Candidates are selected through a walk-in interview. Interviews are held subject by subject:

rows.subject: Chemical/ Mechanical/ Electrical Engineering/ Chemical Science & Technology/ Nanoscience & Technology

faq.question: Q1. How many posts does this addendum add?
faq.answer: It adds 5 posts: 1 Senior Project Associate, 2 Project Associate-I and 2 Project Assistant-II.

faq.question: Q2. Can a diploma holder apply?
faq.answer: Yes. The Project Assistant – II post needs a 3 years Diploma in Mechanical/ Electrical Engineering. The maximum age is 35 years, and the stipend is Rs. 20,000/- plus HRA.

faq.question: Q3. Can M.Sc. Chemistry graduates apply?
faq.answer: Yes, for the Project Associate – I post, which also accepts a B.E./B.Tech. in Mechanical/ Chemical Engineering. The stipend is Rs. 25,000/- plus HRA.

faq.question: Q4. What experience does the Senior Project Associate post need?
faq.answer: It needs 2 years of R&D experience, along with a Ph.D in Chemistry/Chemical Sciences & Technology or an M.E./M.Tech. in Nanoscience & Technology. Experience in electrochemistry or electrochemical energy-related fields is desirable.

faq.question: Q5. On which date is the Chemistry interview?
faq.answer: The Chemistry interview is on 12 November 2026 (Thursday), starting at 09.00 AM. The engineering, Chemical Science & Technology and Nanoscience & Technology interviews are on 13 November 2026 (Friday).

faq.question: Q6. What time should I reach the venue?
faq.answer: The reporting time is 08.30 AM at CSIR-CECRI, Karaikudi.

faq.question: Q7. On what date is age counted?
faq.answer: Age is counted on the date of your interview. The maximum is 40 years for Senior Project Associate and 35 years for the other two posts.

faq.question: Q8. Are these permanent jobs?
faq.answer: No. These are project personnel posts on a temporary basis under Project No. GAP 25/26.
